t: You're looking at the InterContinental London Park Lane, a five-star hotel at 1 Hamilton Place, right on Hyde Park Corner where it meets Park Lane. Knightsbridge and Piccadilly are both close by. It's operated by the InterContinental Hotels Group. The building was designed by Frederick Gibberd, an English architect and town planner. He's best known for Liverpool Metropolitan Cathedral, for his work in Harlow in Essex, and for the widely used BISF house. So this is one of his designs, sitting at one of London's busiest corners.
